name: WF01 - Lead Intake & Qualification
description: Receives authenticated website lead inquiries from Express POST /api/leads, returns HTTP 202 acceptance, and orchestrates validation, AI qualification, deterministic scoring, HubSpot sync, and Slack alerts.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, status: "accepted", workflow: "wf01-lead-intake-qualification", submission_id: $("Normalize Lead Data").item.json.submission_id, contact_id: $("Resolve Contact ID").item.json.contact_id, inquiry_id: $("Insert Inquiry").item.json.id, received_at: $("Normalize Lead Data").item.json.received_at } }}

assignments.name: result

nodes.name: Validate Lead Payload
nodes.notes: Defense-in-depth payload schema validation matching 03-api-and-rls-contract.md (Set IIFE pattern).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, data: null, error: { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: $("Validate Lead Payload").item.json.result.validationError, details: $("Validate Lead Payload").item.json.result.details }, request_schema: $("Validate Lead Payload").item.json.result.requiredSchema } }}

nodes.name: Normalize Lead Data
nodes.notes: Pure deterministic lead payload normalizer synced with n8n/code-nodes/normalize-lead.js.

nodes.name: Check Duplicate Submission
nodes.notes: Idempotency check on inquiries.submission_id before any writes or AI calls.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, data: null, error: { code: "CONFLICT", message: "Duplicate submission_id", details: [{ field: "submission_id", message: "An inquiry with this submission_id already exists" }] }, existing_inquiry_id: $("Check Duplicate Submission").item.json.id ?? null } }}

nodes.name: Lookup Contact by Email
nodes.notes: Looks up existing contact by normalized lowercase email (matches contacts_email_unique).

nodes.name: Update Existing Contact

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ $('Normalize Lead Data').item.json.company_name ?? $('Lookup Contact by Email').item.json.company_name ?? null }}
={{ $('Normalize Lead Data').item.json.phone ?? $('Lookup Contact by Email').item.json.phone ?? null }}

nodes.notes: Updates existing contact while preserving non-null company_name and phone when omitted.

nodes.name: Resolve Contact ID
nodes.notes: Unifies Update Existing Contact and Create Contact branches into one stable named reference.

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ { submission_id: $('Normalize Lead Data').item.json.submission_id, contact_id: $('Resolve Contact ID').item.json.contact_id, contact_existed: $('Resolve Contact ID').item.json.contact_existed, consent_to_email: $('Normalize Lead Data').item.json.consent_to_email, consent_source: $('Normalize Lead Data').item.json.consent_source } }}

nodes.name: Return Database Error

parameters.responseBody: ={{ (() => { const msg = String($json.error?.message ?? $json.message ?? ''); const isDup = /23505|duplicate key/i.test(msg); if (isDup) { return { ok: false, data: null, error: { code: 'CONFLICT', message: 'Duplicate submission_id', details: [{ field: 'submission_id', message: 'An inquiry with this submission_id already exists' }] } }; } return { ok: false, data: null, error: { code: 'UPSTREAM_ERROR', message: 'Unable to persist lead intake record' } }; })() }}

nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 409 if Postgres unique violation (race-condition duplicate submission_id) or sanitized HTTP 502 otherwise.
